sentences.english: The cow is eating grass.
sentences.chinese: 那头牛在吃草。
sentences.scene: 在乡下看到牛群时的简单描述

sentences.english: We saw a black and white cow on the farm.
sentences.chinese: 我们在农场看到一头黑白花的奶牛。
sentences.scene: 参观农场时向朋友分享所见

sentences.english: Every morning, the farmer milks the cows before sunrise, and the fresh milk is delivered to the local store.
sentences.chinese: 每天清晨，农夫天没亮就起来挤牛奶，新鲜的牛奶会被送到当地的商店。
sentences.scene: 描述农场清晨的日常工作

sentences.english: I want to ride a horse.
sentences.chinese: 我想骑马。

sentences.english: My uncle has a beautiful brown horse on his ranch.
sentences.chinese: 我叔叔的牧场里有一匹漂亮的棕色骏马。

sentences.english: When I was little, I was scared of horses, but after taking riding lessons, I now love galloping through the fields.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候很怕马，但上了几次骑术课之后，我现在特别喜欢在田野里策马奔腾。
sentences.scene: 从怕马到爱上骑马的转变

sentences.english: The sheep is white and fluffy.
sentences.chinese: 那只绵羊又白又蓬松。

sentences.english: There are many sheep grazing on the hillside.
sentences.chinese: 山坡上有许多羊在吃草。

sentences.english: During our trip to New Zealand, we visited a sheep farm and watched the farmer shear the wool off a sheep, and it was fascinating.
sentences.chinese: 我们去新西兰旅行的时候，参观了一家绵羊农场，还看了农夫给羊剪羊毛，真是太有意思了。

sentences.english: The pig is sleeping in the mud.
sentences.chinese: 那头猪在泥里睡觉。

sentences.english: Pigs are actually very smart animals.
sentences.chinese: 猪其实是非常聪明的动物。

sentences.english: My grandma used to raise a pig in her backyard, and I remember feeding it leftover vegetables every evening.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶以前在后院养过一头猪，我记得每天晚上都拿剩菜叶去喂它。
sentences.scene: 回忆乡下奶奶家的养猪趣事

sentences.english: We have chicken for dinner.
sentences.chinese: 我们晚饭吃鸡肉。

sentences.english: The chickens are running around in the yard.
sentences.chinese: 那些鸡在院子里到处乱跑。
sentences.scene: 看到农家院里的热闹景象

sentences.english: When I visited the farm, a chicken chased me all the way to the gate, and I've been a little afraid of them ever since.
sentences.chinese: 我去农场玩的时候，一只鸡一直追我追到大门口，从此以后我就对鸡有点心理阴影了。

sentences.english: I like fresh tomatoes in my salad.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在沙拉里放新鲜的西红柿。
sentences.scene: 准备食物时表达口味偏好

sentences.english: My mom grows tomatoes in our garden every summer.
sentences.chinese: 每年夏天我妈妈都会在花园里种西红柿。

sentences.english: I tried to make homemade pasta sauce, but I added too many tomatoes and it ended up way too sour.
sentences.chinese: 我试着自己做意面酱，但西红柿加多了，结果做出来太酸了。
sentences.scene: 下厨做菜的一次失败经历

sentences.english: Look, there's a bee on the flower!
sentences.chinese: 看，花上有只蜜蜂！

sentences.english: A bee stung my finger when I was playing outside.
sentences.chinese: 我在外面玩的时候一只蜜蜂蜇了我的手指。

sentences.english: Bees are so important for our environment because they help plants grow by carrying pollen from flower to flower.
sentences.chinese: 蜜蜂对我们的环境非常重要，因为它们通过传播花粉来帮助植物生长。
sentences.scene: 谈论蜜蜂对生态的贡献

sentences.english: I saw a mouse in the kitchen.
sentences.chinese: 我在厨房看到一只老鼠。

sentences.english: My computer mouse stopped working, so I need a new one.
sentences.chinese: 我的电脑鼠标坏了，我得买个新的。

sentences.english: We had a mouse in the house, and my dad set up a humane trap to catch it and release it in the field.
sentences.chinese: 我们家进了一只老鼠，我爸设了一个人道捕鼠笼把它捉住，然后放归到了野地里。
sentences.scene: 处理家里老鼠的温和方式

sentences.english: Rabbits love carrots.
sentences.chinese: 兔子爱吃胡萝卜。
sentences.scene: 喂兔子时的童谣式对话

sentences.english: I chopped some carrots and added them to the soup.
sentences.chinese: 我切了些胡萝卜放进汤里。

sentences.english: I'm not a big fan of cooked carrots, but I love snacking on raw carrot sticks with ranch dressing.
sentences.chinese: 我不太喜欢吃煮熟的胡萝卜，但我超级喜欢蘸着田园沙拉酱生吃胡萝卜条。

sentences.english: I want baked potatoes for lunch.
sentences.chinese: 我午饭想吃烤土豆。

sentences.english: We need to buy a bag of potatoes from the store.
sentences.chinese: 我们得去商店买一袋土豆。

sentences.english: My favorite comfort food is mashed potatoes with lots of butter and gravy.
sentences.chinese: 我最爱的治愈美食就是加了大量黄油和肉汁的土豆泥。
sentences.scene: 谈论最能抚慰心灵的食物

sentences.english: I don't like green beans.
sentences.chinese: 我不喜欢四季豆。
sentences.scene: 小孩对蔬菜的直言不讳

sentences.english: My mom steamed some fresh green beans with garlic.
sentences.chinese: 我妈妈蒸了一些新鲜的四季豆，放了蒜。

sentences.english: At Thanksgiving dinner, the green bean casserole with crispy onions on top is always the first dish to disappear.
sentences.chinese: 感恩节晚餐时，那种上面有脆洋葱的四季豆焙盘菜总是头一个被抢光的。
sentences.scene: 感恩节家庭聚餐上的抢手菜

sentences.english: Can I have some water?
sentences.chinese: 我可以喝点水吗？

sentences.english: She can speak three languages fluently.
sentences.chinese: 她能流利地说三种语言。

sentences.english: I found an old can of peaches in the back of the pantry from three years ago, and I'm not sure if it's still safe to eat.
sentences.chinese: 我在储藏柜最里头找到一罐三年前的黄桃罐头，我不确定还能不能吃。
sentences.scene: 清理柜子发现过期罐头

sentences.english: I bought a box of chocolates.
sentences.chinese: 我买了一盒巧克力。

sentences.english: We need a box of crayons for the art project.
sentences.chinese: 我们做美术作业需要一盒蜡笔。
sentences.scene: 准备手工材料时的对话

sentences.english: My grandmother keeps a box of old letters and photos under her bed, and she takes it out whenever I visit.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶床底下藏了一盒旧信件和老照片，每次我去看她她都会拿出来。
sentences.scene: 翻看奶奶珍藏的记忆盒子
